source.note: The Official Consolidated Version on jerseylaw.je, 'compiled and issued under the authority of the Legislation (Jersey) Law 2021'. It was read on 2026-08-02 at the point in time 'Showing the law from 16 October 2025 to Current', and on 2026-09-23 the page showed the same point in time ('Showing the law from 16 Oct 2025 to Current'). The consolidated text omits the enacting formula. 'authority' is taken from the publisher's copyright page (read 2026-09-23), under which the States Assembly is entitled to copyright in any Jersey legislation. The terms are the Open States Assembly Licence – Jersey v1.0; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md.

encodings_note: One row, and it encodes the charity-test cluster only (Articles 5-7, with the Article 1 and 2 definitions it needs), not the Law. A second, independent encoding of the same Articles exists in legalese/l4-ide as a paper case study (paper/case-studies/charities-jersey-2014/, 12 modules covering the whole Law). It is not a row here. This row's report/ files compare the two.
